name: Challenge EI
tagline: Notes, reports and invoicing for Early Intervention therapists
role: Mobile app development by the Softwhere team for Challenge EI

scenes.title: A therapist's day in one app
scenes.body: Today's sessions, pending notes and reports due up front, with the schedule and caseload one tab away.

scenes.title: Session notes built for EI billing
scenes.body: ICD-10 and CPT codes, IFSP outcomes and progress per objective, saved on the phone until signed.

scenes.title: Every note tracked to submission
scenes.body: Started, completed, submitted, missed and cancelled sessions, with one tap to submit all completed notes.

scenes.title: Progress reports before they're due
scenes.body: Reports are flagged due soon or overdue; each is a four-part checklist signed and submitted in-app.

scenes.title: No invoice until notes are in
scenes.body: Pending or unsubmitted session notes keep the next invoice locked until they're resolved.
